sections.overview: This southern South American pike cichlid inhabits the Laguna dos Patos and Lagoa Mirim basins; unlike the Amazonian C. tigrina and C. strigata accounts below, its range lies in Brazil and Uruguay.
sections.identification: FishBase describes an elongated freshwater fish and records a maximum standard length of 23.1 cm.
sections.habitat: It is a benthopelagic fish of the subtropical southern-basin waters, not a riverine Amazon species.
sections.diet: The species-specific sources consulted here do not provide a documented prey list, so its diet is left unspecified.
sections.behavior: Published species summaries used here provide little species-level behavioral detail.
sections.reproduction: The consulted accounts do not establish this species’ spawning period or clutch size.
sections.ecology: The Uruguay freshwater-fish guide places the species in the Laguna Merín basin and includes it among taxa prioritized by the national protected-area system.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports a global IUCN assessment of Least Concern, dated 2020.
